description: Unsigned transaction posting a standing offer on a position in the version 2 trade account: once its LTV (Morpho's own, at the market's oracle) reaches at_ltv, anyone may put in what brings it back to to_ltv, up to max_usdg; the account's own idle money goes in ahead of the rescuer, who is owed back ahead of the owner plus fee_bps of what it put in (1 to 2000), earned over term_days (1 to 30, default 7), and may foreclose on that position alone after the term. at_ltv under the position's LLTV, to_ltv under at_ltv; expiry_days (default 30) is when it lapses untaken. No money moves when it is posted. At most 4 live offers an account, one per position. While one is live, max_slip_bps and the agent's slip may come down and never up. From the agent: within the owner's cap (agent_bailout_max_usdg) and at least 10.0 USDG, on positions it may trade, at_ltv at least 200 bps over the position's LTV now, 2 times its fee on max_usdg counted into today's loss budget when posted. Refused in words when the position is not held, a bailout is owed, the position carries an offer, the bounds are off, or the agent's limits refuse it; warns when it is takeable at once or when max_usdg is short of what a rescue at at_ltv would take. Simulated from the wallet (the owner or the agent).

account.description: A version 2 trade account's address (default: the wallet's own, as its owner; an agent gives its owner's account)

at_ltv.description: The LTV a rescue opens at: a fraction under 1, like 0.7 (a percent with its sign is taken too)

expiry_days.description: Days until the offer lapses if no one takes it (default 30, at most 365)

fee_bps.description: The rescuer's fee on what it puts in, earned over the term, in hundredths of a percent (1 to 2000)

max_usdg.description: The most a rescuer may put in, in whole USDG as a decimal string, like "250"

side.description: short (the account's short on the stock) or long (its leveraged long)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

term_days.description: Days the owner has to repay before the rescuer may foreclose (1 to 30, default 7)

to_ltv.description: The LTV a rescue must bring it back to, under at_ltv

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
